distributions: uniform across each tolerance band; diode leakage multiplier log-uniform 1..10 on the typical value; see decks/liveness_corners.cir

requirements.A: steady gate >= that draw's Q3 threshold + 0.5 V (model full-on point); also counted against the fixed 2.085 V
requirements.B: pickup <= 15 ms (half the firmware's 30 ms precharge); 30 ms also counted
requirements.C: no formal requirement; counted against the existing 0.2 s test bound, with and without the firmware's 20 ms
requirements.D: single-edge peak <= that draw's Q3 threshold - 0.1 V; also counted against the threshold itself
